Incompatibility. Calcium salts have been reported to be incompatible with a wide range of drugs. Complexes may form resulting in the formation of a precipitate. Freely soluble in water; slightly soluble in alco- hol. A 5% solution in water has a pH of 7.2 to 8.2. Store in air- tight containers. USP 31 (Calcium Acetate). A white, odourless or almost odour- less, hygroscopic, crystalline powder. It decomposes to calcium carbonate and acetone when heated to above 160°.
